changes.comment: Remove the recordIdField prop. Record identity is declared per doctype (primaryKey, falling back to id) and resolved through Doctype.getRecordId, which is the key Stonecrop.getRecords stores a record under; a per-shell string cannot answer a per-doctype question, and whenever the prop did override the declaration it produced a row link to an HST key nothing was stored under. Both known consumers set it to a value the declaration already yields, so no observable behaviour changes
